verdict.rationale: The public dos.fl.gov start-business page offers Print & Mail PDF forms for Profit and Non-Profit Articles of Incorporation, and the probe confirms these guidance pages are openly reachable, so the core of the story is met. The evidence covers only a subset of forms, and there is no explicit confirmation that downloads need no account. Missing for 10: evidence that filing instructions are downloadable, downloadable paper forms for LLCs and other entity types, an explicit no-account statement, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the PDF downloads.
